name: normalise-forecast
summary: Turn one weather provider's payload into the canonical shape every other module in this app agrees on.
_why_this_exists: So that exactly ONE module knows what open-meteo's JSON looks like. Every other module reads the canonical shape, which means switching provider is a new implementation of this contract and touches nothing else. Without this module, the provider's field names would be smeared across four modules and 'change provider' would be a rewrite.

name.description: the place name — the provider's forecast endpoint does not return one

date.description: ISO yyyy-mm-dd, as the provider gave it — never re-derived from a clock

highC.description: rounded HALF AWAY FROM ZERO. Pinned, because Python's round() is banker's rounding and JavaScript's Math.round is not, so two honest implementations disagree at exactly .5 unless the rule is stated.

precipMm.description: one decimal place, rounded half away from zero
